Every family has one car that worries everyone else.

The kid's first car. The parent's old sedan. The one that gets driven hard and serviced never. Almost a year in with the {{{VEHICLE}}}, you know what a plan feels like: the noise is just a noise, not a bill.
Point your phone at that car's plate. The tool prices a plan in about a minute. If it rates, you can put it on a 0% plan like yours and give the person who drives it the same two phone numbers you have.
